title: Number Sense Kitchen
shareTitle: Number Sense Kitchen — Count, Fill, and Mix with Chef Ravi
description: Join Chef Ravi in a handcrafted Toy kitchen: spot cookie groups at a glance, fill five- and ten-frames one ingredient at a time, and combine two fruit groups into a delicious total.
learningGoals: Subitize stable groups of 1, 2, and 4 without counting every object
Build quantities 3, 5, and 8 with one-to-one correspondence in five- and ten-frames
Compose totals 3, 5, and 8 by combining two visible fruit groups
interactionModel: Choose one of three picture recipes. Tap the matching Toy number plaque in Cookie Jar; drag an ingredient to the frame or use tap-tap placement in Frame Bakery; drag or tap-place both countable groups into the bowl in Fruit Bowl. Keyboard Enter and Space follow the same paths.
feedbackModel: Every correct action physically changes the Toy kitchen: cookies travel into the jar, fruit snaps into the next frame well, and group pieces resolve into individually countable fruit in the bowl. Warm spoken modeling supports retries; each completed recipe earns a distinct medal badge with no timer, score loss, or failure state.
